title: Commonwealth Gas Company files for review and approval, an agreement for quasi-firm gas sales service along with its associated agreement for quasi-firm transportation service with University of Massachusetts Dartmouth.
filings: APPROVAL by the Department of the Agreements and also GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure of the terms to be purchased under the agreement. Commissioners participating were: Howe, Chairman; and Commissioner Besser.

Commonwealth Gas Company supplies its response to Information Request DPU-1-1. The Company also request that parts of this filing be protected for public disclosure. By: David T. Griffiths, Senior Rate Analyst, ComGas.
